board: The ferry pushes off. The jetty grows small behind you.
land: The far bank slides past, and the ferry swings round for home.
The jetty again. Your legs take a moment to remember the ground.
back: The ferryman turns the bow for home without a word.
The jetty again, sooner than you thought.

events.title: A drifting crate
sign: Something knocks against the hull, low and hollow.
met: You hook the crate and haul it in. Rope, and dry cord inside.
missed: The crate turns once in the wake and is gone.

events.title: A passenger
sign: A traveller sits by the mast with a bundle on her knees.
met: "For the cough. Thank you." She presses a leaf into your hand.
missed: She looks at the water and says nothing more.

events.title: Gulls over a shoal
sign: Gulls circle low ahead, and the water darkens under them.
met: The line jerks twice. Two fish, silver and cold, flap in the boat.
missed: The gulls fall behind, still screaming over the shoal.

events.title: A squall
sign: The sky darkens in the west. The ferryman reefs the sail.
met: You bail and trim until the rain moves on. The far bank shows, wet and grey.
missed: The water rises faster than you bail. The ferryman turns for home.

events.title: A bell in the fog
sign: Fog closes over the bow. Somewhere, a bell.

act.clue: The bell rings on the left, then again on the right, louder.

met: The bell comes up out of the fog on a post. A reed is tied to it.
missed: The bell fades. The ferryman circles once, then turns for home.
